domains.name: Fundamental principles and concepts of an occupational health and safety management system (OH&S MS)
Occupational health and safety management system (OH&S MS)

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the fundamental principles and concepts of an occupational health and safety management system, providing the baseline knowledge for understanding how these systems function within an organization to maintain safety standards.

This section focuses on the specific occupational health and safety management system structures and requirements, ensuring candidates understand the framework necessary to implement and maintain compliant safety systems in a professional business environment.

This domain examines the fundamental audit concepts and principles required for effective auditing processes, emphasizing the core methodologies that lead auditors must apply to ensure consistency, accuracy, and reliability throughout the entire audit lifecycle.

This section details the necessary steps and documentation required for preparing an ISO 45001 audit, helping candidates learn how to organize resources and review documents before the actual on-site audit process begins.

This domain focuses on the practical execution and methods for conducting an ISO 45001 audit, providing insight into on-site procedures and the techniques required to gather objective evidence during the audit of a management system.

This section addresses the procedures involved in closing an ISO 45001 audit and reporting findings, ensuring that auditors can effectively communicate results, verify corrective actions, and finalize the audit process according to established standards.

This domain covers the responsibilities and processes for managing an ISO 45001 audit program, including the administrative tasks and strategic planning required to maintain an ongoing, effective audit schedule for an entire organization.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared for the 80-question format. Manage your time effectively across all seven domains to ensure you meet the 70% passing score requirement for certification and demonstrate your professional knowledge.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 80 questions that cover seven distinct domains of occupational health and safety auditing, requiring a clear understanding of the material to succeed in the assessment.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: Candidates must achieve a passing score of 70% to successfully pass the ISO 45001 Lead Auditor Certification exam and earn their professional credential from the certifying body.
Please check with PECB for specific duration details regarding the exam delivery and scheduling, as these parameters can vary based on the testing center and the specific delivery method chosen.
This certification is administered and certified by PECB based on ISO 45001 audit standards, ensuring that all successful candidates meet the requirements set for lead auditors globally.
If you are looking for a successor exam, check with PECB for the current certification path, as they maintain the standards for all professional occupational health and safety audits.

editorial.meta_description: Prepare for the PECB ISO 45001 Lead Auditor Certification by studying audit principles, occupational health and safety management systems, and audit program.

methodology.summary: This page was constructed using verified facts from official PECB documentation and exam guides, ensuring alignment with current requirements and providing accurate information for all prospective certification candidates seeking to understand the exam structure.

editorial.overview: The ISO 45001 Lead Auditor Certification, certified by PECB, covers occupational health and safety principles, audit concepts, preparation, execution, closing, and program management. Candidates must complete an 80-question exam to demonstrate their competence in managing ISO 45001 audits. This certification validates the ability to lead audit teams while ensuring compliance with international standards for occupational health and safety management systems within various organizational environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the seven domains, focusing on audit conduct, preparation steps, and management principles. Practice applying the 70% passing threshold criteria to sample questions to gauge your readiness. Additionally, check with PECB for any available official study materials to supplement your learning and ensure you are prepared for the exam format and the 80-question structure.
editorial.who_should_take: Professionals seeking to lead audit teams for occupational health and safety management systems. This is ideal for auditors, consultants, and safety managers with relevant workplace experience needing formal certification from PECB to advance their careers.

lifecycle.summary: PECB's current candidate handbook for the exam is published and dated: 'ISO 45001 Lead Auditor Candidate Handbook Version 2.1', setting out the live exam competency domains and the registration and certification process.
